name: Disneyland Rancho del Zocalo Pollo Asado / Carne Asada Burrito (Ask for Dry / No Sauce & No Beans)
brandOrRestaurant: Rancho del Zocalo Restaurante (Frontierland · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: A warm oversized flour tortilla filled with grilled chicken or steak, Spanish/white rice, and shredded cheese—as long as you ask the counter to hold the refried beans and red guajillo chili sauce on top.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At the counter, ask for the Chicken or Beef Burrito **"Dry (no red sauce on top) and no beans"** with rice and cheese only.
watchOuts: Default Sonora Burrito is smothered in red guajillo sauce and filled with refried beans—always request dry and bean-free
